intro: 12 個訂購耗材情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

words.zh: 穩定的、規律的、可靠的;持續的

ex.en: If we order new paper and ink at the beginning of every month, we will have a consistent supply of these necessary items.
ex.zh: 如果我們在每個月初訂購新的紙張和墨水,就能有穩定的必需品供應。

ex.en: We order from that supplier because of the consistent quality of their merchandise.
ex.zh: 我們向那家供應商訂貨,是因為他們商品的品質一貫穩定。

note: be consistent with sth 與⋯一致
consistency 一致性;inconsistent 不一致的

ex.en: The stationery department plans to diversify its offering of paper products.
ex.zh: 文具部門計畫擴大紙製品的供應項目。

ex.en: The consultant that we hired recommends that we don't diversify at this time.
ex.zh: 我們聘請的顧問建議我們現階段不要多角化經營。

note: diversification 多樣化;diverse 多樣的;diversity 多元性

ex.en: The new enterprise quickly established an account with the office supply store.
ex.zh: 這家新公司很快就在辦公用品店開了帳戶。

ex.en: This enterprise has become unmanageable and is beginning to lose money.
ex.zh: 這項事業已變得難以掌控,並開始虧錢。

note: small enterprise 小型企業;private enterprise 民營企業

ex.en: Essentially, she wants to win the contract and put the competition out of business.
ex.zh: 基本上,她想贏得合約並把競爭對手擠出市場。

ex.en: After distributing all of the cartridges that were ordered, we were essentially left with none.
ex.zh: 在分發完所有訂購的墨水匣後,我們基本上已所剩無幾。

note: essential 基本的、必要的;essence 本質

ex.en: This room will function as the supply closet while the office is being painted.
ex.zh: 辦公室粉刷期間,這個房間將充當備品儲藏室。

ex.en: What is the function of this device?
ex.zh: 這個裝置的功能是什麼?

note: functional 實用的;functionality 功能性

ex.en: I've been maintaining a list of office supplies that are in greatest demand.
ex.zh: 我一直在維護一份需求最大的辦公用品清單。

ex.en: Trying to maintain two different stockrooms is too much work.
ex.zh: 要同時維持兩間不同的儲藏室,工作量太大了。

note: maintenance 維護;maintainable 可維持的

ex.en: I've been trying to obtain a list of supplies from the administrator for three weeks now.
ex.zh: 我試著從行政人員那裡取得一份用品清單,已經三個星期了。

ex.en: We can obtain all the supplies we need online.
ex.zh: 我們需要的所有用品都能在網路上取得。

note: 比 get 更正式;衍生 obtainable 可獲得的

ex.en: A prerequisite for ordering supplies is getting the approval of the office manager.
ex.zh: 訂購用品的先決條件,是取得辦公室經理的核准。

ex.en: Here are the prerequisites that you need to purchase before coming to class.
ex.zh: 這些是你上課前需要先購買的必備項目。

note: a prerequisite for / of sth 是⋯的先決條件

ex.en: The most important qualities we look for in a supplier are reliability and quick response.
ex.zh: 我們在供應商身上最看重的特質是可靠度與迅速回應。

ex.en: I don't recommend ordering supplies from that website since the quality of their merchandise is usually poor.
ex.zh: 我不建議向那個網站訂購用品,因為他們商品的品質通常很差。

note: quality control 品質管制;high / poor quality 品質高或低
表「特質」時為可數名詞,例句 a 用複數 qualities

ex.en: Thanks to our smooth transition to the new supplier, there was no interruption in shipments.
ex.zh: 多虧我們順利過渡到新的供應商,貨運沒有中斷。

ex.en: Her smooth manner won her the appreciation of the manager but not her colleagues.
ex.zh: 她圓滑的態度贏得了經理的欣賞,卻沒贏得同事的好感。

note: a smooth transition 平順的過渡

ex.en: This website is a good source for paper and other office supplies.
ex.zh: 這個網站是紙張和其他辦公用品的好來源。

ex.en: The source of this rare pottery that we are selling in our shop is a small village in India.
ex.zh: 我們店裡販售的這批稀有陶器,來源是印度的一個小村莊。

note: source of income 收入來源;a reliable source 可靠的來源

ex.en: We do not have enough stationery, so please order some more.
ex.zh: 我們的文具不夠了,所以請多訂一些。

ex.en: The new stationery featured the company's logo in blue ink at the top of the page.
ex.zh: 新的信紙在頁面上方以藍墨水印著公司商標。

note: stationery 是文具;stationary 是靜止的
